symptom: `marketplace install` of Agent Editor 2.7.0 (content 257918) imported AgentEditorCommons but not the protected add-on module AgentEditor the same .mpk carries as `modules/AgentEditor.mxmodule`; Studio Pro 11.16 then reported "unknown type 'agenteditor.agent'" and agent documents would not open, while mx check, mxbuild and run --local stayed green
cause: InstallPackageFiles installs only the entries package.xml lists under <files> (mendixlabs/mxcli#1487), and the add-on module package is not one of the module's own project files. An add-on has no unit in the .mpr: Studio Pro keeps it as modules/<Name>.mxmodule and loads its extension (and the document types it defines) from that file, so dropping it removes the add-on without touching anything a model check reads
insight: A declared-files filter is right for metadata and wrong for a second module riding in the same package: the shape modules/<Name>.mxmodule (a direct child, canonical spelling) is what marks it, so it is a project file whatever package.xml says, and it still goes through the joined-path traversal guard before the filter is asked. The failure is invisible to every check mxcli and mx run, because the add-on contributes Studio Pro extension code, not model; the only probes are Studio Pro itself and `mxcli show modules`, which lists the add-on as Packaged, Protected AddOn once the file is there (#1780's reader). The verified workaround (extracting the entry by hand) is what the fix now does on install and update, and update overwrites the file so the extension's version follows the module's; an .mxmodule a newer package no longer ships is left in place, like every other bundled file
